method: Post-draft self-review of exact saved text; separate scientific review checked findings and source limits.
score_reason: Concrete experiment, outcomes and limits lead; protocol and validation records retain technical structure.
confidence_reason: Subjective editorial self-review without held-out calibration.

examples.quote: The benchmark is the equally weighted mean of all eight control outcomes.
examples.impact: States the scientific question or comparator concretely.

science_gate_reason: Compared stated estimand, margins, windows, paired block units and limits with frozen protocol, driver and summary outputs; independent review checked findings.
facts_gate_reason: Raw ledgers, exact replay, independent block/summary audit, timing and file checksums support claims within stated scope; original metadata-label error remains explicit.
references_gate_reason: Named local reports, scripts and result files exist; source archives and commits are bound by checksums.
calibration_status: No held-out style controls used; perceived style only.
